notes.title: Another Space Opera - Play the DEMO now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=4o7ORb3M8VU;full][/previewyoutube]

We're pleased to announce that a Free DEMO of [b]Another Space Opera[/b] is Now Available on Steam for a limited time, for [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42897881/21f40d8cd249aed9c73b455c42ca56c3b4479001.gif[/img]

We invite you to immerse yourself in this mesmerizing fusion of pixelated action and cinematic storytelling, as the game's meticulously handcrafted pixel art transports you into humanity's dark and decadent future, beset with otherworldly horrors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42897881/f98280f54139102a95e030e2902d2f32975f428b.gif[/img]

Play through the DEMO of [b]Another Space Opera[/b] today and get a taste of what awaits! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42897881/44004259d9faf73b9d713e8b75fe80586605e024.gif[/img]

[i]-PM Studios & Terminist Arcade[/i]
